title: Security incident response and operational escalation
workflow: Detect event and create immutable time-stamped incident case
Assess financial-integrity, confidentiality and operational impact
Preserve logs, relevant service snapshots and chain of custody
Approve bounded containment actions under incident commander
Reconcile accounts, authorizations, credentials and external outcomes
Restore service only after independent security/finance operations review
invariants: Never edit bank journals to hide a compromise
Security containment cannot fabricate financial settlement or reconciliation
Evidence access must be restricted to authorized incident responders
Regulatory notification dates require applicable verified legal policy
Emergency privileges expire with independent after-action audit
Affected customers and legal entity must be scoped precisely
planned_tests: Operator cannot erase initial incident event
No unreviewed reopening of affected payment route
approval_gate: CISO/operations incident playbook, institution notification/legal policies, tabletop and actual exercise evidence.
